question: He is also known as the God of ghatam. Who is 'He' in the preceding line?
solution:
The correct answer is __**TH Vinayakram.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **TH Vinayakram** is an **Indian percussionist** who is known for his mastery over the ghatam, a clay pot that is used as a musical instrument in South Indian classical music.
 
• He was born in **1942 in Chennai **and started learning music from his father, who was a** mridangam player.**
 
• Vinayakram has won numerous awards for his contributions to **music,** including the **Padma Bhushan and the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ustad Bundu Khan** is a **Pakistani classical musician** who played the **sarangi.**
 
• **Pandit Ravi Shankar** was an** Indian sitar player **and composer who was known for popularizing Indian classical music in the West.
 
• **Ustad Bismillah Khan **was an **Indian shehnai player** who was also known for his contributions to Indian classical music.
